Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1212; hidden, figuratively, indistinct:--appear not, uncertain.
BiblicalUsage: Adelos means hidden or indistinct — something you cannot see clearly enough to be sure of it. Jesus used it of unmarked graves that people walked over without knowing, and Paul used it of a trumpet giving an uncertain sound, so no one knew whether to prepare for battle.
TheologicalSignificance: Nothing here asks for a theological system; the word simply does its job in the text, and the passage does the teaching; in this case, the verse is Luke 11:44.
